subject: Integration hold — request for short extension and sandbox credit to complete connector work
messages:
From: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@bluesigma.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@bluesigma.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps + demo this week?

Hi Tessa,

Quick update from our side — our infra team hit a blocker while wiring up the Quicksync adapter to our staging environment. The connector hangs when we send a 50k batch (we've attached a trimmed integration-error-log.txt).

We still want to move forward with the pilot, but this delays the demo and the POC timeline by at least a week while engineering reworks the adapter.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend our sandbox by one week so we don't lose the environment state?
- Would it be possible to get a small top-up of sandbox credits to run a couple extra heavy-load passes?

Priya is copied to coordinate dates. Thanks for the quick help — we want to keep momentum but need some runway.

Best,
Sam Bennett
Head of Integrations, BlueSigma Systems

Attachments: integration-error-log.txt (text, 18KB)
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@bluesigma.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@bluesigma.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + demo this week?

Sam — thanks for the log and the heads up. Sorry to hear about the hang, but good that you caught it in staging.

Short answer: we can absolutely give a one-week extension and provide a sandbox credit bump to cover the extra stress testing. I need to confirm exact credit amount with ops (looping Marissa).

Proposed next steps:
1) We’ll extend your sandbox expiry by 7 days from current end date (I’ll confirm the exact new date once Marissa signs off).
2) We can provision a temporary 200k token sandbox credit top-up for the heavy-load runs, valid for the extended week.
3) If you prefer, we can schedule an engineering sync between your infra lead and our runtime team to triage the hang — Carlos (contractor) mentioned he can join.

Can you confirm: which day next week works for a short 30–45m triage call? I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock the slot.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none
From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc:
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 08:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + demo this week? (internal)

Tessa / Marissa — saw Sam’s log. Looks like a KV cache flush race condition when batch size > 32k on their adapter; we can workaround with a config change but it requires them to rebuild the adapter image and run one compatibility pass.

Impact: 3-4 engineer-hours on their side, 1-2 engineer-hours from our runtime team if we do a joint debug session.

Regarding credits/extension: I think 200k tokens is reasonable for one week. We should record this as a one-off promotional sandbox uplift tied to the BS-2026-0418 deal and mark it non-recurring. Also recommend we add a short clause in the HubSpot deal notes that Redwood will provide one short extension + credits for integration blockers.

If Marissa approves, I’m happy to be on the triage call and help validate the fix.

— Dev 
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Sam / Priya — approved.

We’ve extended BlueSigma’s sandbox expiry by 7 days (new expiry: 2026-03-16T23:59:59Z) and issued a one-time 200,000 token sandbox credit top-up. Token credit is marked "promo-topup-BS-200k" in our billing system and will not auto-renew. I’ve also added a short note on the HubSpot deal that this is a one-off to help unblock integration work.

Carlos — if you and Sam want a joint debugging session, please suggest 2 slots (30–45m) and Dev will join. We’ll keep the scope to triage + confirm the adapter config rebuild.

Sam — glad we can keep the demo on track. Please confirm the preferred triage slot and whether you want Redwood to kick off the calendar invite.
